title: Owner: create the fine-grained GitHub token and place it in NERV
goal: The owner creates a fine-grained token limited to Actions read and write on voidbrain/coordinator and places it on the main base as F-132-T01 describes
acceptance: A fine-grained token: resource owner voidbrain, only voidbrain/coordinator, repository permission Actions: Read and write (Metadata read-only is added by GitHub), an expiry date
Placed on NERV-01 with the command from F-132-T02 as a private file; never pasted in chat, git or a ticket; `nerv doctor` shows its age only
privacy: Neutral invented repositories, workflows and runs in tests; the GitHub token never in git, config.json, tests, logs, chat or the relocation snapshot.
validation: Owner procedure, recorded in F-132 Verification
escalation: The owner decides the token expiry

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: a few minutes on github.com and one command. Not a measurement.
